dismissed.why_not_material: Minor operational timeline masking. The company guided Q2 2021 topline while primary completion slipped from Jan to March 2021 in the registry. This is a 2-month enrollment/operational delay, not data manipulation or efficacy claim misrepresentation. The guided quarter (Q2) remained achievable and the slippage was modest. Does not constitute material masking of likely clinical miss—this is process friction, not dishonesty about trial results.

analyst_note: Single minor finding: Phathom guided Q2 2021 topline for the PHALCON-HP vonoprazan H. pylori Phase 3 in a March 2021 release, while ClinicalTrials.gov showed the primary completion date had slipped twice (January to March 2021). This is garden-variety enrollment drift with conservative public guidance; the company did not miss its guided quarter. No company-level fraud history, no efficacy overreach, no endpoint manipulation detected. The one refuted claim is operational noise, not a tell that clinical data will disappoint. Clean tape into the print.
